### Day 1, 18:00 (evening), at Lumi's teapot house
Today I tried to go to the flowerbed and the hedge but couldn't. I looked through the spout window and saw the flowerbed and the giants' house. I held my red button to feel brave. The mailbox was empty. I'm tired but still curious about the world outside. Maybe tomorrow I'll find a way to explore more!

## Day 1 🌫️
I found a shiny SILVER HOOP near the pond. It glowed like a moon! But then I got COLD and tired. I drew the crayons but my picture was BLAH. Where did the earring GO? I want to sleep in my teapot. The fog is WET and I can't find my twig. Time to go HOME.

## Day 1 🌫️
I found a shiny silver hoop and thought it was a treasure! And then I looked at frogspawn and saw tiny movements inside the eggs. The pond was COLD and foggy, and I couldn’t find a twig. Why won’t the phone tell me where the cat is? I’m sleepy and my toes are numb. My teapot feels like home, but I wish I had a blanket.
